label: Reply
description: Answer the caller of this run with one message: behind a Route, the whole response (status, headers, body) and the exchange ends; behind a Socket, one message and the socket stays open (status and headers refused). A stored file anywhere in a json body goes out as `{ url, mimeType, filename, sizeBytes }`; sent as bytes it goes out under its own content type and filename unless `headers` sets them.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Any value on json, a String on text, a stored file on bytes.

inputs.name: answerAs
inputs.label: Answer as
inputs.description: `json`, `text` or `bytes`; empty follows the trigger's `dataType`. A GET answering a picture sets `bytes`.

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: Extra response headers (Route only); a content-type here overrides the body's.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the message was handed to the caller.

then.message: Reply '{id}' answers nobody: no trigger with a live caller (a Route, a Socket) starts a run that reaches it. Wire it from the trigger's run (through data, or `_should_flow`), or put it in a group the trigger's `_should_flow` runs.
Reply '{id}' runs after {with}, which already sent the response's head to the HTTP caller, so this answer can never go out. To end the exchange after a stream, use a Close.
